d: We help men save their marriages through results-oriented online coaching, often succeeding where traditional counseling falls short.
Check out Marriage Reset YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/@marriagereset) and Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/joshhudson.marriagereset/).

We are looking to hire someone who can take full ownership of paid client acquisition at an eight-figure men's coaching company and to run a marketing turnaround. Your scope is paid media, conversion, conversion-rate optimization, and email; organic is a separate function you coordinate with, not run.

Three years ago this funnel produced a ROAS most operators would envy, but today it produces a fraction of its peak; this is where you come in and take over. You report to the CEO, work closely with the founder, and the intent is that within your first months you are running this function end to end. You inherit a proven funnel, years of data, and the current team. Find out what actually broke, fix it, raise the standard of everything we produce, and build the team this business needs to scale to the next level. For the right person, this seat carries a path to CMO.
q: Ran or led marketing for offer(s) doing $1M+/month within the last 18 months –verifiable
Deep high-ticket call-funnel experience –optimizing to booked calls and sales, not to leads

Expert Meta media buying with real Andromeda-era fluency –creative-as-targeting, concept-level testing, pixel conditioning –familiar with what experts like Jeremy Haynes teach, and able to teach it back to our team
Proven creative and hook direction, with receipts (ads you directed and the numbers behind them)
Managed a marketing team of 5+ (copywriters, editors, media buyers, social media managers) to a visibly high standard
Built or rebuilt marketing processes and lifted the output quality of a creative team (editors, designers, copywriters), not just managed headcount
Compliance-sensitive vertical experience: you've operated where an account can die overnight
Google Ads at expert level (strong working competence is preferred)
Experience in a relationship, men's transformation, or adjacent emotional-transformation niche, and specific concepts you'd test for a marriage offer
Hyros, GoHighLevel, ClickFunnels fluency; split-testing tooling that tracks from opt-in to sale (like convert.com)
r: Paid media strategy and results. Account structure and testing methodology with our external media-buying partner-they execute, you direct.

Scaling and budget doctrine. Lead quality end-to-end; stop teaching the algorithm to bring us men who can't afford the program. A CPM-reduction program. The call on whether and how to expand Google ads, which currently outperforms Meta on ROAS, but ad spend has halved compared to 2 years ago.
Growth economics. You own the forecast - revenue → calls → cost per qualified call → spend → creative volume -and rebuild it monthly. You allocate budget across Meta, Google/YouTube, and Bing.

Creative and messaging direction -Our biggest gap and your biggest lever. You own the flywheel: mine sales calls and best-customer language → turn that language into hooks, angles, and ads → iterate based on which calls actually close. You own the avatar architecture -high-income professionals and the broad market - and every ad concept ships with a written hypothesis, target avatar, and rationale. You watch our ads and VSL the way a prospect would and tell us what they actually make you feel. AI pre-checks are fine; AI-only reviews are not. You must be able to write (VSL copy and direct-response copy) and you write it yourself when it matters most; otherwise you brief and direct the copywriters. You own the VSL improvements and iterations, creative volume and diversity targets, and final quality control on everything that ships.

Compliance and account safety. After handover: the compliance guide, the final-review gate on every ad and page, the multi-account testing ladder, platform-policy watch, and the playbooks for operating through restrictions. This is institutional knowledge the founder transfers to you directly.

Data, tracking, and attribution. You own our conversion-event architecture, what we send to each platform and at what quality threshold, one of our most important levers on lead quality. You decide with our media buyer on how to manage event routing, run our pixel-conditioning strategy including the up-market experiments, and keep one canonical weekly scoreboard with funnel data by stage.

Funnel and CRO. Front end above all: ads, opt-in, VSL, application, booking, confirmation pages. Structured split testing from opt-in through sale -not just top-of-funnel CTR. Funnel-architecture bets: direct-to-VSL, no-opt-in variants, persona-specific funnels.

Email. You own the email number and the learning loop between email and paid: sequences and broadcasts built from the same angles as the ads, and winning email concepts fed back into the ads pipeline. The copywriters write; you set direction and hold the standard.

Team leadership. You inherit the current team- copywriters, video editors, production, the external media-buying partner, our senior direct-response marketer, and the growth operations coordinator- and you own the team from there: raising the standard, and the hiring decisions that come with making sure this function succeeds. Weekly plans, structured meetings, quarterly performance reviews, and hiring through our scorecard-based process. You design the team this mission needs and recruit A-players into the gaps. You also set the standard for this department and hold the team to it: clear expectations, direct feedback, and the harder conversations when someone is not meeting the bar. You will have our full backing on those calls. You also own how this department runs day to day: the processes, the production pipeline, and the throughput and quality of our creative and editing output.

Competitor and market intelligence . You regularly watch and analyze competitor ads and VSLs and tell us specifically how to compete in the market better, not just provide an AI summary of an ad library.

AI-first operation . Our goal is to run lean and leverage AI heavily. You use Claude and Claude Code daily for analysis, research, SOPs, compliance pre-checks, and you build systems, not just outputs.
In 6 months: ROAS is back toward its historical level, revenue growing again, and a marketing department that holds a standard without the founder inside it.
In 18 months: this business at a scale it has never reached, with you as the person who took it there -CMO title, profit-share tied to business growth.
x: Work from Anywhere - Fully remote position | Full-time | Core hours in the European or Dubai time zone.
Performance Bonus - Annual bonus of up to 10% of your fee, tied to targets fully within your control.
Please review the job description carefully. If your experience aligns with the role and this opportunity excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Note: We appreciate the time you put into applying. Our review process takes 1–2 weeks, and we’ll reach out if you’re shortlisted. If you haven’t heard from us within two weeks, we won’t be progressing your application this time.
Thank you for your interest in Marriage Reset!

d: Introducing Raffles Al Areen Palace Bahrain, an extraordinary addition to Raffles Hotel's renowned portfolio. This ultra-luxury property offers a unique experience as "The Palace of the Secret Garden." With 78 private pool villas ranging from 1 to 3 bedrooms, Raffles Al Areen Palace Bahrain redefines luxury hospitality in Bahrain. Our spacious villas, starting from 400 sqm, feature private pools and jacuzzis, providing guests with ultimate relaxation and privacy. Our dedicated team of Raffles Legendary Butlers ensures exceptional service and attention to detail, creating unforgettable moments for each guest. Conveniently located just 40 minutes from the airport and 30 minutes from the City Center, Raffles Al Areen Palace Bahrain offers easy access to Exhibition World Bahrain, Bahrain International Circuit (BIC), and the Al Dana Amphitheater, making it an ideal choice for cultural, entertainment, and business destinations.
Financial Accountability: Responsible for maximizing room revenue by full filling guest needs
Conditions of Work: Normal administrative office and hotel working conditions.
Role Overview Purpose: To maximize room revenue and profit through pro-active selling techniques and referrals across the resort. To provide a point of contact for all Revenue associated processes.

Achieve targeted goals in the LQA, Forbes, Hotel Mystery Shopping calls and LISTEN calls.
Maintain the accuracy and cleanliness of the PMS Database.
Ensure market segmentation is accurate for each reservation.
Ensure reservations meet the property standards in terms of accuracy of data and guest satisfaction.
Produce quotations and written confirmation to FIT guest & Travel agencies.

Support the Reservations Team, Sales and Revenue Management with special projects as required.

To actively participate in maximizing revenue through up-selling & cross-selling by using effective upselling techniques.

Ensure confidentiality and secure storage of all intellectual property and data bases, both hard copy and electronic. Adhere to Accor Internet and Email policy
Ensure Hotel, Customer and Staff information or transactions are kept confidential during or after employment with the company.

Carries out additional tasks & training sessions from time to time, by request of senior team members which may not be directly related to the job role but necessary for the smooth operation of the resort
Opportunity to join the first Raffles in Bahrain
Employee benefit card offering discounted rates in Accor worldwide
Opportunity to develop your talent and grow within your property and across the world!
Ability to make a difference through our Corporate Social Responsibility activities.

d: Qatar Airways is pleased to announce an exciting career opportunity for a Senior Manager - IT Enterprise & Cloud Platforms.

This strategic leadership role is responsible for defining and executing the vision, strategy, architecture, engineering, implementation, operations, and continuous enhancement of Qatar Airways' enterprise technology platforms. The successful candidate will lead the organization's hybrid cloud ecosystem spanning Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and on-premises private cloud environments.
The Role Will Oversee Critical Technology Domains Including
Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Services
Database Platforms and Private Cloud Services
Middleware Technologies and Enterprise Integration Services
IT Service Management (ITSM) and Operational Excellence
Platform Reliability, Availability, Performance and Capacity Management

As a key technology leader, the Senior Manager will drive innovation, modernization, automation, security, resilience, and operational efficiency across Qatar Airways' enterprise platforms. The position plays a pivotal role in ensuring the stability and scalability of business-critical services while enabling the organization's digital transformation agenda.

The successful candidate will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, technology partners, cybersecurity teams, and senior leadership to deliver world-class enterprise platform capabilities that support Qatar Airways' continued growth and operational excellence.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of enterprise technology within one of the world's leading airlines while leading high-performing teams across cloud, infrastructure, and platform engineering disciplines
r: Prepare strategy for designing and implementing hybrid cloud platform (Azure, GCP, OCI) and roadmaps, preferably open architecture, for all QR application systems and establish the target-state architecture and standards for cloud services, database platforms, middleware and ERP platform.
Champion a cloud-first, automation-first and secure-by-design culture across the operations organization.
Define the IT service management, IT service continuity (BCP/DR) and enterprise monitoring strategy and roadmap, aligned with business priorities and industry frameworks (ITIL 4, ISO/IEC 20000).

Research, develop, test and evaluate new cloud services and technologies, preferably enterprise open standard technologies and products in the areas of application hosting, databases, platform technologies and tools ensuring QR stays as close to “leading edge technologies” making sure upgrade/change decisions are pragmatic and cost effective.
Manage and run the Operational and Business critical production applications to make sure that agreed levels of service levels are met.
Lead workload migration and modernization programmes, applying appropriate rehost, re-platform and refactor patterns, including containers and Kubernetes (AKS / GKE/ARO) and platform services.
Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, ARM), CI/CD pipelines and policy-as-code to standardize provisioning and enforce compliance.

Own enterprise middleware and integration platforms, including application servers, API management, enterprise service bus, message queuing and integration services (for example Oracle Fusion Suite, IBM MQ, MuleSoft, RedHat Integration Services, Solace etc.).
Own database operations across Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, open-source and cloud-native database platforms, including performance tuning, patching, backup and recovery, and database security.

Provide technical consultancy and guidance to databases and middleware technologies teams in using enterprise open-source technologies to reduce the operating cost of running business applications without compromising on quality.

Partner with ERP functional teams and business process owners to ensure stability of finance, procurement, HR, asset management and commercial processes. Plan and deliver ERP upgrades, patching and cloud migration (Oracle Cloud).
Manage ERP and other platform licensing compliance, system access controls and segregation-of-duties support in coordination with Security and Audit.

Responsible for setting clear and consistent performance objectives, implementing performance management and development plans to ensure standards of performance and productivity are achieved and maintained enabling a high-performance culture and build succession and skills plans, including Qatarization development goals.

Own the enterprise monitoring and observability platforms (infrastructure, application, synthetic and log monitoring), integrated with ITSM processes. Define onboarding standards so that every Tier 0 and Tier 1 service is monitored before go-live, manage alert quality and noise reduction, and publish service availability dashboards and reports.
Prepare and manage the annual OPEX and CAPEX budgets for the platforms in scope, and present business cases for investment to senior leadership
Establish and run a FinOps practice covering cost visibility, tagging, rightsizing, reservations and savings plans, and chargeback.

Ensure robust high availability and disaster recovery designs aligned with business RTO and RPO targets, and own an annual DR test calendar by service tier, including ERP, with documented runbooks, failover and switchback evidence and RTO/RPO results.
Maintain a DR gap register and report recovery readiness to IT leadership and Internal Audit.
Proven background in research, recommend and develop implementation of Hybrid Cloud including Databases, platform technologies and tools

Managerial skills - Ability to delegate work, set clear direction and manage workflow. Strong mentoring and coaching skills. Ability to train and develop subordinate's skills. Ability to foster teamwork among team members
Experience in Business application support and maintenance
